meta.description: Manage your trading accounts, deposits, withdrawals and verification.

shell.searchHint: Accounts, transactions and help articles become searchable as those sections go live.
shell.notificationsEmptyBody: Deposit, withdrawal, verification and ticket updates appear here.
shell.comingSoonBody: {feature} isn't available yet. We'll let you know in Notifications when it's ready.
shell.buildingBody: It's part of a later build phase.
shell.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
shell.unavailableTitle: We can't reach our servers right now
shell.unavailableBody: Your account and funds are safe. This is usually brief. Reload in a moment, or sign out and back in.

login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to {brand}
login.subtitle: Manage your accounts, funds and verification.
login.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.oauthError: We couldn't sign you in with that provider. Try again or use your email.

emailCode.heading: Sign in with an email code
emailCode.body: We'll email you a 6-digit code. It's valid for 10 minutes.
emailCode.sentTo: Enter the code we sent to {email}.

qr.heading: Sign in with the {brand} app
qr.body: Open the {brand} app on your phone, tap Scan, and point it at this code.
qr.alt: QR code for signing in with the {brand} app
qr.error: We couldn't create a QR code. Try again.

telegram.heading: Sign in with Telegram
telegram.body: You'll confirm in Telegram, then come straight back here.

register.title: Create account
register.heading: Create your {brand} account
register.subtitle: It takes about a minute. We'll ask for verification details later.
register.countryHint: Detected from your connection. Change it if it's wrong.
register.referralHint: From the person who invited you.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.heading: Check your email
verifyEmail.body: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. It's valid for 10 minutes.
verifyEmail.bodyNoEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email. It's valid for 10 minutes.
verifyEmail.changeBody: We'll send a new code to this address.
verifyEmail.changed: Email updated. We sent a new code.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.heading: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your account email. We'll send a 6-digit code to reset your password.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.heading: Set a new password
reset.body: We emailed a 6-digit code, valid 10 minutes. If an account exists for that email, the code is on its way.
reset.successBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.expired: This reset request has expired. Start again.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.heading: Two-step verification
twoFactor.bodyTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.bodyEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}.
twoFactor.signOut: Sign in with a different account

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again, or reset your password.
errors.CODE_INVALID: That code is incorrect or has expired. Check it or request a new one.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead, or reset your password.
errors.FLOW_EXPIRED: This request has expired. Start again to get a new code.
errors.CSRF: Your session needs a refresh. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
validation.passwordRules: Your password doesn't meet all the rules below.
validation.passwordMismatch: The passwords don't match. Re-enter the new password.
validation.termsRequired: Accept the terms to create your account.
validation.referralInvalid: Referral codes use letters, numbers and dashes only.
validation.labelTooLong: Labels can be up to 40 characters.
validation.termsRequiredLeverage: Confirm you've read the terms to continue.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.bodyTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to {action}.
stepUp.bodyEmail: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email} to {action}.
stepUp.startError: We couldn't start verification. Try again.

home.subtitle: Here's where your money is right now.
home.summaryNote: Live accounts only, in USD. Cent accounts are converted at 100 USC = $1.00.
home.noAccountsTitle: You don't have a trading account yet
home.noAccountsBody: Open a live account to start trading, or a demo account to practise with virtual funds.
home.recentEmptyBody: Deposits, withdrawals and transfers will appear here.

accounts.title: Trading accounts
accounts.subtitle: Live, demo and archived MT5 accounts.
accounts.withdrawDisabledZero: Nothing to withdraw: free margin is {amount}.
accounts.withdrawDisabledStatus: Withdrawals aren't available on a {status} account.
accounts.depositDisabled: Deposits aren't available on a {status} account.
accounts.tradeDisabled: Trading isn't available on a {status} account.
accounts.emptyLiveBody: Try a different search or filter.

emptyTab.live: You don't have a live account yet
emptyTab.demo: You don't have a demo account yet

emptyTabBody.live: Open a live account to start trading.
emptyTabBody.demo: Practise with virtual funds on a demo account.
emptyTabBody.archived: Accounts you archive appear here. You can still view their history.

rename.title: Rename label
rename.body: Give {account} a name you'll recognise. Only you see it.
rename.label: Label
rename.hint: Up to 40 characters. Leave it empty to show the account ID ({account}) instead.

archive.title: Archive {account}?
archive.body: It moves to the Archived tab. You can still see its history. Only accounts with zero equity and no open positions can be archived.

leverageDialog.title: Change leverage
leverageDialog.risk: Higher leverage means bigger gains and losses from smaller price moves, and a margin call sooner. Only choose what you can manage.
leverageDialog.blocked: You have {count, plural, one {# open position} other {# open positions}} on this account. Close them before changing leverage.
leverageDialog.terms: I understand how leverage affects my risk and accept the leverage terms.

passwordDialog.title: Change MT5 password
passwordDialog.body: For {account}. The new password works in MT5 straight away.
passwordDialog.masterHint: Full access: trade and manage the account.
passwordDialog.investorHint: View-only access, for sharing with someone who should not trade.

accountDetails.subtitle: {type} · {server}
accountDetails.notFoundBody: It may have been closed, or the link is wrong.
accountDetails.masterPasswordBody: Full trading access. We never show it after the account is opened.

guideSteps.2: In MT5, choose File → Login to trade account (or Settings → New account on mobile).
guideSteps.3: Enter login {login}, your master password, and server {server}.

openAccount.title: Open account
openAccount.subtitleLive: A live MT5 account for real-money trading.
openAccount.subtitleDemo: A demo MT5 account with virtual funds.
openAccount.label: Label (optional)
openAccount.labelHint: Up to 40 characters. You can change it later.
openAccount.successBody: Save these details now. For your security we won't show the passwords again.
openAccount.error: We couldn't open the account. Nothing was created. Try again.

positions.title: Positions & history
positions.subtitle: Open trades, pending orders and closed trades, synced from MT5.

charts.empty: No closed trades in this period.

empty.closed: No closed trades on {account} in this period

positions.emptyBody: Trades you place in MT5 show here within a few seconds.
positions.noAccounts: You don't have a trading account yet
